name: Mech-o Café
source:
Do you like big buff men? Do you like robots? Do you like big buff robots but can't find any game that merges both? Well, you're in luck!

In a world where the creation of Makrinos, a new kind of sentient humanoid robots, redefined society, play as Corey (or your own name) and discover "Mech-o Café", a macho café with quite an exceptional staff...

[From [url=https://xanster.itch.io/mech-o-cafe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你喜欢大块头的男人吗？你喜欢机器人吗？你是否喜欢大块头机器人，但找不到任何融合两者的游戏？嗯，你很幸运！

在Makrinos（一种新型有感知能力的人形机器人）的诞生重新定义了社会的世界里，扮演Corey（或你自己的名字）并探索“Mech-o Café”，这是一家拥有非常出色的员工的男子气概咖啡馆……

[来自[url=https://xanster.itch.io/mech-o-cafe]itch.io[/url]]
